history.rationale: The focus threshold 'more than one hundred deaths or over $1 billion in damages from weapons of mass destruction or cyberterrorist attacks on critical infrastructure' becomes 'a Catastrophic Risk', defined in footnote 1 by the TFAIA as death or serious injury to 'more than 50 people or more than one billion dollars' from a single incident involving expert-level CBRN assistance, an autonomous cyberattack or crime with 'no meaningful human oversight', or evading control.
